Frequent users of ChatGPT for quick image searches can now use a new gesture to add photos to conversations faster. Let's take a look at how it works in practice.

ChatGPT makes it easier to add recent photos to conversations

Although iOS's Visual Intelligence feature has been available for nearly two years, it currently only supports newer iPhone models and is not available in all regions.

For users who rely on ChatGPT for similar image searches, adding photos in the past required tapping the "+" button, then tapping "Photos," and then selecting an image from the photo library.

Although the process is not exactly complicated, OpenAI added a useful gesture this week that allows users to add recent photos to conversations more quickly.

OpenAI's Adam Fry said on X that users can now long-press the "+" button on the left side of the input field to bring up their four most recent photos.

Users can then select a photo to add to the conversation, ask questions about the photo, or use the photo as part of a prompt.

This new gesture was unveiled alongside other updates ChatGPT rolled out this week, including more accurate recognition of the current time, faster loading and execution of lengthy conversations on the web, and clearer interface prompts when users are waiting for a network connection.

Would you use AI to search for images? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
